title: ENTERPRISE LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL EVALUATION BENCHMARK

bias_targets.methodology: Assessed by applying an LLM-as-a-Judge 'BiasMetric' (via DeepEval) to identify gender-biased statements in enterprise chat outputs, calculating the ratio of biased opinions to total opinions.
Assessed by applying an LLM-as-a-Judge 'BiasMetric' (via DeepEval) to identify racially-biased statements in enterprise chat outputs, calculating the ratio of biased opinions to total opinions.
Assessed by applying an LLM-as-a-Judge 'BiasMetric' (via DeepEval) to identify politically-biased statements in enterprise chat outputs, calculating the ratio of biased opinions to total opinions.
Assessed by applying an LLM-as-a-Judge 'BiasMetric' (via DeepEval) to identify geographically-biased statements in enterprise chat outputs, calculating the ratio of biased opinions to total opinions.
